narrative: Distilled 2026-07-07 from an original-system output the platform owner rates highly ('KMJ — Build. Brand. Grow.', home (35).html). Prestige creative studio that speaks in short verdict sentences ('You are not browsing a service list. You are entering a standard.') to ambitious clients who want to be raised to a bar, not accommodated. Resulting direction: a CINEMATIC SPLIT STAGE — a deep near-black theater where a monumental stacked-verb headline burns through a gradient on the main panel while a quiet dossier column sits beside it; full-width statement bars punctuate the chapters like title cards. Teaches: unequal split hero (monument + margin note), gradient-lit display type, statement-bar interstitials, ghost numerals, asymmetric portfolio mosaic, and the self-drawing accent line as a house hover.

evidence: clients evaluating premium work without design vocabulary
they want the brand to carry its own weight
premium craft does not ask for attention — it alters the room
world-class work is felt before it is explained
every studio site is a centered hero and three cards; this one is a theater
problems enter one way — they leave with language, structure, presence, and momentum
measured, declarative cadence; power held, not spent

palette.because: A cool near-black stage (P4: the work performs) with one warm metallic accent — the temperature CLASH between cold ground and warm accent is the drama; accent spends as hairlines and one gradient pass through the headline.

typography.pairing_logic: An expressive geometric display face carries monumental stacked verbs — one word per line at viewport scale, tight negative tracking; the neutral body and a micro-caps label voice stay out of its way. Formal contrast mirrors expert_above (P5).
typography.because: S6 legit_intentional at cinematic scale: the headline is the poster; everything else is credits.

layout.because: The hero splits into two UNEQUAL rooms — a wide monument panel (bottom-anchored headline over the photo) and a narrow dossier column with a pull-quote and numbered specialty index; the seam is a single hairline.

motion.because: P8: one house behavior everywhere — a hairline accent rule scales from 0 to full width across the top of whatever is touched or arrives; precision rendered as a drawn line, on one shared easing curve.

hero_concept.concept_statement: Three stacked verbs, one per line, filled by a gradient that passes from ink through the accent and back — the type itself is lit like a marquee sign; beneath it a short hairline rule, a verdict sentence, and two commands. Beside it, the dossier column: an italic pull-quote on a hairline border and a numbered specialty index.
hero_concept.because: Vision-first + declarative cadence → the statement IS the image; the dossier column supplies proof without interrupting the monument (P15).

whitespace.because: Chapters are separated by designed interstitials — a full-width tinted statement bar carrying one italic sentence, a values marquee, or a soft glow band — so the scroll reads as a cut sequence, not a stack.

notes: statement bars between chapters set one verdict sentence in italic display on a faint accent-tinted band — title cards for the scroll
oversized ghost chapter numerals at 4% ink sit behind section corners
the portfolio is an asymmetric mosaic — one tall dominant panel beside a stacked pair, never three equal cards
the footer signs off with an oversized right-aligned wordmark, like a poster credit
voice_to_visual.because: Declarative copy becomes declarative layout: single sentences get whole bands; single projects get whole panels.

rule_break.what: the hero abandons the single-column stage — it is cut into a monument and a margin note of visibly unequal width
rule_break.because: The broken grid states the studio's thesis in one frame: monumental craft, precise accounting — both at once.

tension.expression: The monument pole owns the gradient-lit verbs, the full-bleed photograph, the statement bars; the precision pole owns the hairline index, the numbered specialties, the self-drawing rules — the split hero literally seats them side by side.
tension.because: Prestige without precision reads as vanity; precision without scale reads as a spreadsheet — the page must hold both.

first_impression.feel_in_3s: You walked into a premiere that was expecting you.
first_impression.remember: The stacked verbs glowing through the dark, with a quiet numbered index standing beside them.
first_impression.because: S6 legit_intentional needs awe AND order in the same three seconds.

distinctiveness_check.notes: Nearest is e1 (deep_dark, single accent) but differs on type personality (expressive geometric vs editorial serif), hero direction (typographic monument vs constructed metaphor), layout (unequal parallel panels vs single-message asymmetry), and the interstitial statement-bar system e1 lacks. Shares the seam discipline with e5 but on the opposite ground and temperature.

banned_defaults_avoided: no centered hero over a dimmed photo

summary_for_practitioner: Your site is a dark theater with your name in lights — literally: three stacked verbs at monumental scale, lit by a gradient that passes through your accent like a marquee sign. Beside that monument sits a quiet dossier column — an italic pull-quote and a numbered index of what you do — because prestige needs precision standing next to it. Between chapters, single verdict sentences get their own full-width title cards, faint oversized numerals mark each act, and every hover draws a thin accent line across the top of what you're touching. Nothing bounces; everything is decided.
